children.name: on-screens-of-varying-sizes--the-main-document-card-adjusts-dynamically-in-width-to-match-the-screen-size--the-height-of-the-main-document-card-remains-fixed-across-all-devices-
children.content: On screens of varying sizes, the main document card adjusts dynamically in width to match the screen size. The height of the main document card remains fixed across all devices.

children.name: on-screens-of-varying-sizes--the-main-document-card-adjusts-dynamically-in-width-to-match-the-screen-size--the-height-of-the-main-document-card-remains-fixed-across-all-devices-
children.content: On screens of varying sizes, the main document card adjusts dynamically in width to match the screen size. The height of the main document card remains fixed across all devices.

children.name: neighboring-cards-are-partially-visible-on-the-screen--with-only-20px-of-their-width-shown-on-each-side-of-the-main-card--this-ensures-a-clear-visual-hierarchy--focusing-on-the-main-card-while-hinting-at-adjacent-content-
children.content: Neighboring cards are partially visible on the screen, with only 20px of their width shown on each side of the main card. This ensures a clear visual hierarchy, focusing on the main card while hinting at adjacent content.

children.name: at-the-top-left-corner-of-each-document-card--there-is-a-round-shape-that-enhances-the-card-s-visual-appeal-
children.content: At the top-left corner of each document card, there is a round shape that enhances the card's visual appeal.

children.name: the-shape-features-a-layer-blur-effect-that-mimics-a-glowing--soft-focus-appearance--adding-a-sense-of-dimensionality-
children.content: The shape features a layer-blur effect that mimics a glowing, soft-focus appearance, adding a sense of dimensionality.

children.name: the-national-emblem-image-is-positioned-at-the-top-right-corner-of-the-document-card--it-is-layered-beneath-the-glowing-round-shape-
children.content: The national emblem image is positioned at the top-right corner of the document card. It is layered beneath the glowing round shape.

children.name: the-scrolling-functionality-is-designed-for-card-by-card-navigation-rather-than-free-flow-scrolling--one-swipe-gesture-moves-the-user-to-the-next-card-in-the-sequence--ensuring-precise-navigation-
children.content: The scrolling functionality is designed for card-by-card navigation rather than free-flow scrolling. One swipe gesture moves the user to the next card in the sequence, ensuring precise navigation.

children.name: the-scrolling-functionality-is-designed-for-free-flow-scrolling-
children.content: The scrolling functionality is designed for free-flow scrolling.
